WITH winners AS (
    SELECT ma.player_id, p.bats
    FROM manager_award AS ma
    INNER JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN bats IS NULL OR bats = '' THEN '(blank or missing)' ELSE bats END AS hand,
    COUNT(*) AS winner_count,
    1.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM winners) AS share_of_total
FROM winners
GROUP BY CASE WHEN bats IS NULL OR bats = '' THEN '(blank or missing)' ELSE bats END;
